description: County cash rents in dollars per acre, from the USDA NASS annual Cash Rents survey — each row is one county (or an 'OTHER COUNTIES' aggregate) in one year and one practice category (irrigated_cropland, non_irrigated_cropland, or pasture), with the average rent in USD per acre. Use for what farmland rents for; use get_land_values instead for land values (what the land is worth), and list_coverage to check covered states, counties, and years. Read-only lookup of stored survey data; no API key. The survey is annual and the stored copy refreshes once a year after the August NASS release — the latest stored year is 2026. `state` takes a two-letter code (case-insensitive), `county` a county name exactly as stored (uppercase, e.g. 'HANCOCK'), and `year` a single survey year. Returns up to `limit` rows (default 1000), newest year first; a filter combination with no stored rows returns a no-data result rather than an empty list.

county.description: County name exactly as stored (uppercase, e.g. 'HANCOCK'); some rows are 'OTHER COUNTIES' aggregates covering counties NASS does not publish individually

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'IA' (case-insensitive; stored uppercase)

year.description: Survey year as an integer, e.g. 2026 (currently the only stored year — see list_coverage)

name: get_cash_rents
